units: <cite ref="Zevachim 93b">Zeb. 93ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>וט׳ ולא מספג</he>, v. <cite ref="O01313"><he>סָפַג</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 7:4">Yoma VII, 4</cite> <he>ירד וט׳</he> went down to the bath and took an immersion.
<cite ref="Berakhot 2b:13">Ber. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>שהכהנים טוֹבְלִין וכ׳</he> when the priests (that have been unclean) bathe in order to be permitted to partake of their priestly share; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 22a:19">Ib. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>טוֹבְלֵי שחרין</he> those taking a bath in the morning (after emission of semen virile); Y. ib. III, 6ᶜ top <he>ט׳ שחרית</he>.—

Tosef. Yad. II, 20 טובלי שחרין (Var. טוֹבְלָנֵי) morning bathers (Essenes, v. Graetz Gesch. d. Jud. III2, p. 468, a. for correct vers. R. S. to Yad. IV, 8).—Part. pass. טָבוּל.—טְבוּל יום (one who has bathed in day-time,) one who has bathed but must wait for sunset to be perfectly clean (Lev. XXII, 7).
<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 1:1">T’bul Yom I, 1</cite>; a. fr.—

Nidd. 30ᵃ טְבוּלַת יום ארוך a woman after bathing whose day is adjourned (having to wait a long time for perfect levitical purity).—טְבוּל יוֹם T’bul Yom, name of a treatise of Mishnah and Tosefta of the order of Tahăroth

senses.gloss: to dip into vinegar, salt &c., to make tasty; esp. to take a luncheon, to take the first course of a meal consisting of relishes; to take the antepast.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:1">Maasr. IV, 1</cite> <he>המְטַבֵּל בשדה</he> he who makes a luncheon (of fruits) in the field.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:3">Pes. X, 3</cite> <he>מטבל בחזרת</he> he takes lettuce as antepast.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 10:9">Tosef. ib. X, 9</cite> <he>לא טי׳ וכ׳</he> if he has eaten as antepast only &c.
<cite ref="Pesachim 107b:5">Pes. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>אבל מטבל וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. comment. (ed. <he>מטביל</he>) but he may make a luncheon of &c.

<cite ref="Pesachim 107b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>השמש מטבל בבני וכ׳</he> comment. (ed. <he>מטביל</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 10:5">Tosef. ib. X, 5</cite> <cite ref="M01346"><he>מכביש</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K00081"><he>כָּבַשׁ</he></cite>); a. fr.

senses.gloss: (cmp. תבל) to season with spices. Part. pass. מְטוּבָּל. Y. Shek. III, 47ᶜ top מבושל כמ׳ boiled (wine) is (in ritual law) like spiced wine; v. infra.
to immerse vessels for purification, to order immersion.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 2:3">Ter. II, 3</cite> <he>המַטְבִּיל כלים וכ׳</he> he who immerses vessels on the Sabbath.
<cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:2">Bets. II, 2</cite> <he>מַטְבִּילִין את הכל וכ׳</he> you must immerse whatever needs immersion (both persons and vessels) before &c.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 28b:2">Erub. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מטבילין בו וכ׳</he> they used to season the roast with it (in place of pepper).

senses.gloss: to be immersed, to be made clean.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:6">Mikv. V, 6</cite> <he>לא הוּטְבָּלוּ</he> are not considered as clean through immersion; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 4:10">Tosef. ib. IV, 10</cite>.
